segments.title: Cold Open & Pepito Sign-On
segments.notes: Pepito delivers the station cold-open sign-on from the control room, initiating the live broadcast.

segments.title: News Desk: Trump Dental Visits & Case's Absence
segments.notes: Case Blackwell returns from a week in the Tetons with his sketch group; Jeff Ripple co-anchors. Coverage focuses on Trump's third dentist visit in 2025, chronic venous insufficiency diagnosis, and bruised hands.

segments.title: News Stack: Chat Submissions
segments.notes: Case and Jeff process chat-submitted stories: ELF Cosmetics founder becoming a Catholic priest, Benedict Cumberbatch bicycle fight, 'ball maxing' saline injection trend, and a rectal exam accidentally fixing heart arrhythmia.

segments.title: AI Rooney Viewer Complaints
segments.notes: Case activates AI Rooney for ten viewer complaints; the cyborg commentator generates Andy Rooney-style grievances on topics including leotards, garbage disposals, nipple aging, fist insertions, Big the Cat, Fresno Mormons, Chunky Kong, baseball mustaches, and newsprint comics.

segments.title: Amongst the Web: Viewer Video Reviews
segments.notes: Jeff Ripple hosts the viral media review desk, rating submissions including a Ted Bundy clip, Epstein files reference, a hairy badger, a kid eating a sandwich, ice-breaking trypophobia trigger, baseball celebration dance, and a mechanical table rocker.

segments.title: CryptoZeu$: Castlevania Symphony of the Night
segments.notes: Brandon plays Castlevania: Symphony of the Night via web client, battling controller mapping issues, his mother's interruptions, raccoon infestation lore, and a lack of save points; defeats multiple bosses but dies to axe enemies in a hallway.

segments.title: Sign-Off & Raid to Ricky Peacock
segments.notes: Case wraps the condensed broadcast, announces intent to stream earlier tomorrow, and raids Ricky Peacock's Just Chatting channel.

storylines.beat: [17:47] Case confirms the Crum Dick Punch liability has been 'paid off,' marking the concluded arc's resolution.

lore_notes.fact: Claims to have fought a toilet war on Mars with a plumber army, all of whom died sacrificing themselves to break the spell animating the toilets.
States he dies and becomes a fundamentally different train each time his hype expires, retaining the same memories and personality.
Spent the previous week in the Tetons with his sketch group plotting future group activities.
House windows shattered outward due to internal atmospheric pressure; raccoons now infest the kitchen.
Maintains 'daddy jars' of peanut butter in the basement for his father's potential return; mother inserts hotdogs into them.
Mother yells through bedroom door during streams; refers to him as 'Bran Bran' and critiques his language.

episode_summary: Case Blackwell returns from a Tetons sketch retreat to anchor a condensed broadcast covering Trump's third dentist visit, an ELF Cosmetics founder entering the priesthood, Benedict Cumberbatch's bicycle altercation, and the 'ball maxing' saline injection trend. AI Rooney processes ten viewer complaints with characteristic fixation on garbage disposals, nipple aging, and Big the Cat. Jeff Ripple hosts Amongst the Web reviewing viewer clips, then Brandon (CryptoZeu$) battles Castlevania: Symphony of the Night on a laggy web client while his mother and raccoon infestation provide background chaos. The show raids Ricky Peacock.
